name: Eswatini Cars [TEST] v1.1.0 — Staging build for testing
body:
## TEST BUILD — do not distribute to end users

This is the **staging** APK, used for testing new features before they go to production. It installs ALONGSIDE the production app (different package name), so you can test without affecting your production install.

### What's different from the production APK

| | Production | This staging build |
|---|---|---|
| Package | sz.co.eswatinicars.app | sz.co.eswatinicars.app.staging |
| App name | Eswatini Cars | EC [TEST] |
| Icon | Normal logo | Logo + yellow TEST badge |
| Loads | eswatini-cars.vercel.app | eswatini-cars-git-staging-...vercel.app |
| Coexists with prod? | — | YES (different package) |

### What this build tests

This staging APK loads the Vercel **preview deployment** for the `staging` branch. Every time I push website changes to the `staging` branch, this APK will load the new code on next launch — without you needing to download a new APK.

So the workflow is:
1. I push website changes to the `staging` branch (NOT main)
2. Vercel auto-deploys to the staging preview URL
3. You open this TEST app → it loads the new code → you test it
4. If good: I merge `staging` into `main` → production deploys → all users get it
5. If bad: I fix on `staging` → preview re-deploys → production users never saw the broken code

### For NATIVE (APK) changes

If I need to change MainActivity.java or other native code, I'll build a new staging APK, upload it here as a new version, and you'll download + install it over this one. The production APK on your phone stays untouched.

### Install

1. Download the `Eswatini-Cars-TEST.apk` asset below
2. Open it (allow 'Install from unknown sources' if prompted)
3. You'll now have TWO app icons: 'Eswatini Cars' (production) and 'EC [TEST]' (this staging build)
4. Use the TEST app to verify new features work before I push them to all users

### Verification

- Package: sz.co.eswatinicars.app.staging
- Version: 1.1.0 (versionCode 9)
- Signed with the same keystore as production (SHA-1 69:DF:80:0E:83:22:DA:59:60:1E:E7:3F:55:EC:ED:FB:2C:75:50:B8)
- Loads: https://eswatini-cars-git-staging-eswatini-cars.vercel.app/
